elaine (Finance): Morning — noticed a cluster of ~24 staged invoices in NetSuite with missing VAT code and a handful show repeated promotional credits. Looks tied to last night's webhook window. Can billing ops take a look?

ravi (Billing Ops): On it. Importer ran for batch 2026-09-16-02 twice. First pass ok, second pass produced invoices without tax mapping for some rows.

tom (Eng): Pulled webhook logs. Stripe sent event once but our proxy retried and the retry had a modified Idempotency-Key. Our importer currently dedupes on Idempotency-Key which is the problem. Snippet: event=evt_3AbcX000 deliveries=2 idempotency=key-9a idempotency=key-9a-retry

webhook-bot: webhook evt_3AbcX000 delivered; 2 attempts recorded. See dashboard for details.

ravi (Billing Ops): Listing invoice ids: STG-6001..STG-6024. Duplicates flagged: STG-6010, STG-6017, STG-6023. I'll hold the NetSuite push for that window.

elaine (Finance): Please do not export. I'll prepare a CSV to reconcile Stripe vs staged rows. If credits applied twice we need manual reversals.

tom (Eng): Immediate fix: revert dedupe to stripe.event.id only, pause NetSuite sender, and add a guard to detect same event id with >1 Idempotency-Key within 20m. Following up with a small PR and test harness.

ravi (Billing Ops): Filed ticket BILL-2102 with invoice list and queued manual adjustment requests.

elaine (Finance): Thanks — once you pause exports I'll run the diff and sign off on any reversals. Also let's ask infra to check for any proxy behavior that mutates headers on retry.
